spec_copy.welcome_acknowledgment: We're sorry you're here. Cairn will walk with you one step at a time.
spec_copy.welcome_not_ready_link: Not ready to sign up? See what the first weeks look like.
spec_copy.oauth_cancelled: No problem. You can choose another way whenever you're ready.
spec_copy.email_check_inbox: Check your inbox for a link from Cairn. It may take a minute.
spec_copy.account_exists: It looks like you already have a Cairn account. Last time you signed in with {provider}.
spec_copy.age_under_18: Cairn is built for adults handling these tasks. If you're helping a family member, they can create an account.
spec_copy.privacy_terms_summary: Your privacy matters, especially right now. Cairn never uses your information, or information about the person who died, for marketing or advertising. We do not sell it or share it for ads. We use it only to help you with the steps in front of you. You can delete your account and your information at any time from Settings.
spec_copy.privacy_terms_checkbox: I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
spec_copy.trial_summary: Cairn is free for 28 days, and we will not ask for a card. Your 28 days begin when you start your first case, so nothing counts down while you get settled. After 28 days, a subscription is needed to keep adding and updating your tasks. If you do not subscribe, your account becomes read-only on day 29. Nothing is deleted and nothing is charged. We will remind you before your free time ends.
spec_copy.trial_checkbox: I understand that 28 days after I start my first case, I will need a subscription to keep using Cairn fully.
spec_copy.ai_notice: Before we begin, an important notice. Cairn is an artificial intelligence (AI) guide. It is not a human. It is not an attorney and cannot give legal advice. It is not a therapist, counselor, or medical professional. Cairn helps you organize the steps after a death and points you to official instructions, and it can make mistakes. Whenever your situation calls for an attorney, a therapist, or crisis support, Cairn will always tell you and point you to one. If you are in crisis, you can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
spec_copy.ai_notice_legal: This notice is provided consistent with the disclosure requirements of California Senate Bill 243 (2025), which requires that you be told clearly that you are interacting with an artificially generated assistant and not a human.
spec_copy.ai_checkbox: I understand Cairn is an AI guide, not a human, attorney, or therapist, and is not a substitute for professional advice.
spec_copy.decline_acknowledgment: That's okay. You can't use Cairn without agreeing, but you're not stuck.
spec_copy.preferred_name_question: What would you like me to call you?
spec_copy.personality_question: How would you like me to talk with you? You can change this anytime.
spec_copy.resume_onboarding: Welcome back. You were almost done. Let's pick up where you left off.
spec_copy.crisis_resource: You can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.

spec_copy.trial_reminder_day_21: Your free time with Cairn ends in 7 days, on {trial_end_date}. Nothing will be charged. If you'd like to keep going, you can choose a subscription whenever you're ready.
spec_copy.trial_reminder_day_27: Your free time with Cairn ends tomorrow, {trial_end_date}. Your information stays safe either way. After tomorrow your account becomes read-only until you subscribe.

draft_copy.deletion_explanation: Deleting your account removes your account, your sign-in details, your settings, every case you started, the information about the person who died, and your tasks. This can't be undone. We keep a record that the account existed and was deleted, with no names or details in it.
